method: Two standalone metrics. Total: production rank is season fantasy points among drafted players who have played; value = overall pick # minus that rank. Avg: production rank is fantasy points per game among drafted players with at least 3 games (GP is season points ÷ points-per-game, rounded); value uses that rank. Positive value = outperforming the draft slot. STEAL = round 4 or later and a top-20 producer on that metric, or value +40 and up. BUST = rounds 1–3 and value −25 or worse. Players with no games are excluded from both ranks. Players under the Avg game floor are excluded from Avg ranks only. A legacy prod_rank that averages the two ranks is still emitted for older page shells.
